# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Levi Sees the Vision; Warns Benjamin

---

**19:1** And Levi was a prophet and he saw in his spirit the wickedness of the son of Pharaoh and he was grieved greatly and he told his brother Simeon all the words of the son of Pharaoh.

**19:2** And Simeon said to Levi: 'Let me take my sword and I will kill Dan and Gad, the sons of the handmaids, for they have conspired against our brother Joseph.'

**19:3** And Levi said: 'No, do not do this, for we are men who worship God, and it is not fitting for a man who worships God to repay evil with evil.'

**19:4** And Levi said: 'Rather, let us go at night with our brother Benjamin and watch over the house of Joseph and Aseneth.'

**19:5** And they did so, and armed themselves and went at night to the house of Joseph.

**19:6** And Levi said to his brothers: 'Watch and guard carefully, and let not one of you sleep tonight.'

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
